outcome: AI applications in use are discovered, tested against adversarial prompts before release, and kept inside guardrails that limit what they can do.
overview: Enterprises are shipping applications built on models faster than anyone has agreed how to secure them, and the controls that apply are genuinely new: prompt-injection resistance, model access control, and what an application is permitted to do on a user’s behalf. Cisco AI Defense is aimed at that gap — discovering AI applications in use, testing model behaviour, and enforcing runtime guardrails. This is an emerging category and this record says so plainly: the claims here are unproven, because neither the source nor Redington’s delivery history contains a result to draw them from.

benefits.text: AI applications in use across the enterprise, including unsanctioned ones, are discovered
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Discovery covers traffic the enforcement point can see; an application reached from an unmanaged device outside inspection is invisible

benefits.text: Model behaviour can be tested against adversarial inputs before an application is released
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Testing samples a space that cannot be exhausted; a passing result is evidence of effort, not a guarantee of safety

benefits.text: Runtime guardrails can block classes of prompt and response at the application boundary
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Guardrails are pattern and classifier based and are evadable; they raise cost for an attacker rather than closing the path

residency: Cloud-delivered enforcement and testing; prompts and responses examined by the service leave the customer estate, which for many AI use cases is the decisive question

notFor.situation: An organisation with no AI applications in production or development
notFor.why: There is nothing to discover, test or guard

notFor.situation: A buyer expecting guardrails to make an AI application safe
notFor.why: Guardrails raise attacker cost; application design and data access control determine what an attack can actually reach

scope:
Model: Redington solutions engineering with an accredited Cisco security implementation partner · Duration: 6–10 weeks to an inventory with guardrails on the first applications
Support model: Vendor subscription support; Redington coordinates the vendor case. Given the pace of change in this category, a quarterly capability review is recommended.
1) Position — inspection data-flow and residency position established before commitment
2) Discover — AI applications enumerated from observed traffic and bound to owners
3) Evaluate — applications in development exercised against adversarial inputs with results recorded
4) Guard and hand over — runtime guardrails applied, governance review cycle established
deliverables: The inventory distinguishes discovered applications from those the enforcement point cannot see
Every evaluation result is recorded with the input set used, so the claim it supports is bounded
The handover states in writing what guardrails do not prevent
effort: 6–10 weeks to an inventory with guardrails on the first applications
languages: English delivery; Arabic executive materials on request
